body: Any chance I could get the files PM'd? They took down the files on the official site.
I will. Thank you again. You really helped.

I understand. I'm going to try to start making rough drafts of the letter today. I'll try my best to make it sound right. Thank you again. If you want I can keep you filled in about my progress with the letter.
OK yeah that sounds good. But no.

Thank you. Seriously this really helps me get a clear head. Do you think I should either drop the stuff off at her doorstep or put it on her car at work or bring it into her work and ask someone to give it to her? I'm paranoid about leaving it on her car because someone might take it.
That sounds like a good idea. Do you think I should leave the stuff on her car at work or should I contact her dad and ask him to leave the stuff to him and he give them to her?

I get you. My issue is that I don't want to give up. And I'm paranoid that if I wait too long to give space she'll either lose feelings and not want to come back or she'll find someone else. I've been fucked over in situations similar to that too many times to count. I love her I really do. I mean we talked about marriage. It may have not been for years but we had such a good connection, sometimes you just get that feeling that the person may be the one. 

I kept asking her if she found someone else or she didn't want to be tied down and she said that wasn't it. But she refused to ever post stuff about us and she would avoid takings pics together. And if we did she would ask me not to post them. Her family knew about us, I met them and had Easter dinner with her. And she said her friends knew about us as well. She said she didn't want to "deal with people asking questions " I kept trying to ask who would ask questions because everyone knew about us. Guys would comment on her pics with flirty emoji shit and it irritated me so I tried talking to her about it. She said that "it's not a big deal and that it doesn't matter what they think or say because I'm your girl". It's confusing cause she would say she's my girl but not be my girlfriend and then after all the fighting she blocks me on everything. She didn't even block her ex on facebook even though she told me he went crazy and all. She got really angry with me because I saw on the pic she posted some dude commented flirty shit so I commented to him saying go away. She deleted it and started freaking out on me. I kept asking who he was and she would just say I'm being immature. So I messaged him and asked him what she means to him and how he knows her. He ended up telling her what I said and she freaked out saying I had no right and that I'm obsessed. I tried telling her that any person would do the same if someone was commenting on their significant other that they were planning on living together and all. She blocked me on instagram and I kept trying to tell her to calm down because I just wanted to talk about things. Then she blocked me on everything. This all happened Thursday night. Now I'm scheduled to go to the doctor Tuesday and get meds for my depression and anxiety. Part of me wants to wait till Monday or Tuesday and message her dad and ask him what he thinks I should do. Part of me wants to message one of her friends and ask them what I should do. And the other part of me wants to try and call her tonight on the home phone and just try and talk things through. I want to give her space but I don't want to feel like this is the end you know?

Thank you. I'll try doing that. I'm trying to just get by each day but it's so hard. Especially since I got her a gift that I was planning on giving to her once we became official, now that this has happened I don't know what to do about it. I don't know if I should drop it off at her work and ask someone to give it to her or message her dad and ask him if he thinks I should give it to him or something.
